headline: Chilean Data Centers Face Construction Delays Due to Energy Grid Constraints
summary: Six data center projects in Chile are currently unable to proceed due to an inability to connect to the national electricity grid, highlighting critical infrastructure gaps.
why: Data centers are essential for digital infrastructure. Grid connectivity issues can delay technology investments and hinder the growth of the digital economy in the region.

impacts.name: Data Centers
impacts.why: Infrastructure bottlenecks directly prevent project execution and capital deployment in the sector.
